summary: Christine Drazan posted on X on October 11, 2023, that she stands with Israel in the ongoing war, tagging #IStandWithIsrael. That is the only entry in her record addressing the conflict. Her Oregon gubernatorial platform, covering economy, housing, education, and public safety, contains no language on Palestine, Israel, or Gaza. The unqualified alignment with Israel, stated four days after the war began, is her sole documented position on the issue.
